name: TC-226: the anonymous all-orders dump GET /api/order/now is gone @smoke
description: Before RestauNax #621 this route had no auth middleware and returned every order on the platform (~170 MB of PII on QA). The route is now DELETED: 'now' falls through to the public GET /api/order/:orderId matcher and is treated as an order id, so Express answers 404 ORDER_NOT_FOUND (pinned live on QA 2026-08-19). Anything in the 401/404 family is acceptable; a 200 with a body is the regression this test exists to catch.
